title: Perfect uniformizer reduction commutes with arbitrary direct image
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite intermediate extension in the algebraic closure of Q_l, pi an element generating the maximal ideal of its integer ring O_E, and n a natural number. Write a for the actual condensed reduction O_E -> O_E/(pi)^(n+1) [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams]. For every morphism f:X -> S of schemes and every full universal integral DiagonalRightDerived model R [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], there is a full-unit-normalized RestrictionSquare [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars] between R and the canonical quotient right-derived model [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived]. For every unbounded integral derived object K on X, the scalar mate of this square at K is an isomorphism. This assertion contains no regular or Tate-line endpoint, no supported-source identification, and no trace.

proof.text: Use transparent aliases for the original derived model, normalized square and all-complex mate predicate, to share category instances. Use the rank-one short exact condensed resolution of the actual quotient. The private abstract-coefficient assembly identifies each rank-one regular term with its Fin 1 biproduct, applies the finite-free normalized scalar-squares theorem, and packages the resulting square and its mate invertibility as ScalarSquareIsomorphisms. Specialize this construction to the uniformizer quotient map and R.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_uniformizer_scalar_squares
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (R : ScalarRightDerived (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) f) :
    Nonempty (ScalarSquareIsomorphisms (quotientMap l E π n) f R)
